title: galium mollugo subsp. pycnotrichum
intro: Galium mollugo subsp. pycnotrichum, commonly known as the prickly bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The prickly bedstraw is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, and is used to treat various health issues such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Galium mollugo subsp. pycnotrichum include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
